description: Machine-readable record of one ToonForge episode run: cost, time, QA scores, models. Written by the pipeline on every finished (or failed) run.

api_cost_usd.description: Total Meta Model API spend for this run, USD.

notes.description: Free-text: fallbacks used, warnings, anything a judge should know.

scenes.description: Per-scene QA record, in episode order.

qa_score.description: Final vision-QA score for this scene (pass >= 0.80).

retries.description: How many regenerations this scene needed (max 2).

status.description: ok = finished episode; partial = some stages failed but output exists; failed = no episode.

story_title.description: Title of the input story (or filename stem).

wall_time_s.description: End-to-end wall-clock time, story in to episode.mp4 out.

title: ToonForge run_report
